## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Read one of the user's saved Coach skills in full. Pass a slug from list_skills.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slug` | `string` | Yes | The slug of one skill from your skill list. Max length 40. |
